templates.title: Plone (ZEO + NFS)
templates.description: Plone 6 site with ZEO storage, scalable backend, and Volto frontend. Persistent data on NFS. Per-instance directories must be pre-created by the matching cluster_playbook playbook.
templates.note: Single ZEO replica (cannot scale). Backend and frontend can scale. Requires /srv-nfs/plone/<site-id>/{filestorage,blobstorage} created beforehand by cluster_playbook.

env.name: STACK_NAME
env.label: Stack name (must match the field above)
env.description: Type the same value you used in the stack 'Name' field at the top of this page. Used for internal Swarm DNS (${STACK_NAME}_db, ${STACK_NAME}_backend).

env.name: STACK_PREFIX
env.label: Traefik resource prefix
env.description: Short, unique prefix used in Traefik service/middleware/router names (e.g. 'acme-prod').

env.name: STACK_ENV
env.label: Target environment
env.description: Swarm placement constraint: nodes must have node.labels.env == this value.

env.name: SITE_ID
env.label: Plone site id
env.description: Plone site path segment (e.g. 'Plone'). Used by Volto's API path and the backend VHM rewrites.

env.name: DEPLOY_HOSTNAME
env.label: Public hostname
env.description: Hostname routed by Traefik (e.g. site.example.com). Must already resolve to the cluster.

env.name: IMAGE_FRONTEND
env.label: Frontend image
env.description: Volto image (e.g. plone/plone-frontend or a per-tenant build).

env.name: IMAGE_FRONTEND_TAG
env.label: Frontend image tag
env.description: Pinned tag. Avoid 'latest' in production.

env.name: IMAGE_BACKEND
env.label: Backend image
env.description: Plone backend image (e.g. plone/plone-backend).

env.name: IMAGE_BACKEND_TAG
env.label: Backend image tag
env.description: Pinned tag. Avoid 'latest' in production.

env.name: IMAGE_DB
env.label: ZEO image
env.description: ZEO server image. Override only for a custom-built ZEO.

env.name: IMAGE_DB_TAG
env.label: ZEO image tag
env.description: Bump together with backend ZODB compatibility.

env.name: STACK_FRONTEND_REPLICAS
env.label: Frontend replicas
env.description: Number of Volto replicas.

env.name: STACK_FRONTEND_TYPE
env.label: Frontend node type
env.description: Swarm placement constraint: node.labels.type for the frontend.

env.name: STACK_BACKEND_REPLICAS
env.label: Backend replicas
env.description: Number of Plone backend replicas.

env.name: STACK_BACKEND_TYPE
env.label: Backend node type
env.description: Swarm placement constraint: node.labels.type for the backend.

env.name: STACK_DB_TYPE
env.label: ZEO node type
env.description: Swarm placement constraint: node.labels.type for ZEO. Pin to a node with reliable NFS access.

env.name: ZEO_PORT
env.label: ZEO port
env.description: Port the ZEO server listens on.

env.name: ZEO_STORAGE
env.label: ZEO storage name
env.description: ZEO storage identifier. Rarely changed.

env.name: NFS_HOST
env.label: NFS server
env.description: NFS server address (IP or DNS name).

env.name: NFS_BASE_DIR
env.label: NFS base directory
env.description: Path on the NFS export for this site. Mounted at /data and /data/blobstorage. Must be pre-created by cluster_playbook.

env.name: CERTRESOLVER
env.label: Traefik cert resolver
env.description: Name of the Traefik certificate resolver to use.

env.name: FRONTEND_MIDDLEWARES
env.label: Frontend middlewares
env.description: Comma-separated Traefik middlewares for the frontend route. Add 'mw-<STACK_PREFIX>-auth' to gate the public site behind basic auth.

env.name: BASIC_AUTH_USER
env.label: Basic auth user
env.description: Username for the stack-wide auth middleware (always applied to /ClassicUI; opt-in for the frontend via FRONTEND_MIDDLEWARES).

env.name: BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH
env.label: Basic auth password hash
env.description: htpasswd-style hash. Never the plaintext password.

env.name: NETWORK_MTU
env.label: Internal network MTU
env.description: MTU for the internal overlay network. Lower it if running across VXLAN-encapsulated networks.

env.name: FRONTEND_COMMAND
env.label: Frontend launch command
env.description: Command passed to the frontend image's docker-entrypoint.sh after the env-config wrapper sources /run/configs/frontend.env. Default suits upstream Volto images. Override for non-upstream images with a different CMD (e.g. older Volto using 'yarn start:prod').

env.name: BACKEND_COMMAND
env.label: Backend launch command
env.description: Command passed to the backend image's /app/docker-entrypoint.sh after the env-config wrapper sources /run/configs/backend.env. Default 'start' fires the upstream Plone backend launch path. Override only for images whose CMD differs from upstream.

env.name: BACKEND_ENV_VERSION
env.label: Backend env config version
env.description: Version suffix of the Swarm config providing extra env vars to the backend (mounted at /run/configs/backend.env and sourced before launch). The compose mounts ${STACK_PREFIX}_backend_env_${BACKEND_ENV_VERSION} — the config object must already exist in the cluster. Bump to roll new values.

env.name: FRONTEND_ENV_VERSION
env.label: Frontend env config version
env.description: Version suffix of the Swarm config providing extra env vars to the frontend (mounted at /run/configs/frontend.env and sourced before launch). The compose mounts ${STACK_PREFIX}_frontend_env_${FRONTEND_ENV_VERSION} — the config object must already exist in the cluster. Bump to roll new values.

templates.note: Storage is ephemeral — every container restart wipes the site. Intended for demos, evaluation, and short-lived sandboxes.

templates.title: Plone (RelStorage + Postgres)
templates.description: Plone 6 site with RelStorage against an externally-managed Postgres. Volto frontend + Plone backend, no embedded DB, no NFS. Backend scales freely; blobs live in Postgres.
templates.note: Postgres is NOT part of this stack — provision the database, role and credentials beforehand. Blobs are stored in Postgres (shared-blob-dir disabled), per RelStorage maintainer recommendation.

env.label: Stack name (must match the field above)
env.description: Type the same value you used in the stack 'Name' field at the top of this page. Used for internal Swarm DNS (${STACK_NAME}_backend).

env.description: Short, unique prefix used in Traefik service/middleware/router names (e.g. 'acme-prod').

env.label: Target environment

env.label: Public hostname
env.description: Hostname routed by Traefik (e.g. site.example.com). Must already resolve to the cluster.

env.label: Frontend image
env.description: Volto image (e.g. plone/plone-frontend or a per-tenant build).

env.description: Pinned tag. Avoid 'latest' in production.

env.label: Frontend launch command
env.description: Command passed to the frontend image's docker-entrypoint.sh after the env-config wrapper sources /run/configs/frontend.env. Default suits upstream Volto images. Override for non-upstream images with a different CMD (e.g. older Volto using 'yarn start:prod').

env.name: FRONTEND_HEALTHCHECK_TEST
env.label: Frontend healthcheck test
env.description: Compose healthcheck.test for the frontend, as a CMD-SHELL string. The default 'true' is the shell builtin that always exits 0, so the task reports healthy immediately and overrides any probe baked into the image. Set this to a real probe (e.g. 'curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/') only if your image's CMD is known to bind quickly enough that a real check won't stall rolling updates.

env.name: IMAGE_BACKEND
env.label: Backend image
env.description: Plone backend image. Must include RelStorage and a Postgres driver (psycopg2/psycopg3).

env.name: IMAGE_BACKEND_TAG
env.label: Backend image tag
env.description: Pinned tag. Avoid 'latest' in production.

env.name: BACKEND_COMMAND
env.label: Backend launch command
env.description: Command passed to the backend image's /app/docker-entrypoint.sh after the env-config wrapper sources /run/configs/backend.env. Default 'start' fires the upstream Plone backend launch path. Override only for images whose CMD differs from upstream.

env.name: DB_HOST
env.label: Postgres host
env.description: Hostname or IP of the externally-managed Postgres instance, reachable from Swarm app nodes.

env.name: DB_PORT
env.label: Postgres port
env.description: Postgres port.

env.name: DB_NAME
env.label: Postgres database
env.description: Postgres database name used in the RelStorage DSN (dbname=${DB_NAME}).

env.name: DB_USERNAME
env.label: Postgres role/user
env.description: Postgres role used to connect (user=${DB_USERNAME}). Often the same as ${DB_NAME}, but separated to support managed Postgres setups where the role and database names differ.

env.name: DB_PASSWORD
env.label: Postgres password
env.description: Password for the ${DB_USERNAME} role. Secret — never paste it into a default value.

templates.title: Swarm Cronjob
templates.description: Single-replica controller (crazymax/swarm-cronjob) that schedules cron-like jobs on Swarm services via labels on the target services. Deploy one per Swarm cluster.
templates.note: Pinned to a manager node (needs the Docker socket). The compose hard-codes replicas: 1 — two parallel controllers would double-fire every job.

env.name: IMAGE_CRONJOB
env.label: Cronjob image
env.description: swarm-cronjob image. Override only for a private mirror.

env.name: IMAGE_CRONJOB_TAG
env.label: Cronjob image tag
env.description: Pinned tag. Avoid 'latest' in production.

env.name: TZ
env.label: Timezone
env.description: IANA timezone used to evaluate every swarm.cronjob.schedule expression (e.g. America/Sao_Paulo).

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.label: Log level
env.description: Logger verbosity.

env.name: LOG_JSON
env.label: JSON logs
env.description: Emit JSON-formatted logs. Useful when shipping to a log aggregator.
